nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the shared GATE subjects, outcomes, root causes, source types, exam ranges, question formats, timing targets, and application defaults.

nodes.name: examYears
nodes.summary: Generates a descending valid year range for an exam source based on the current exam cycle.

nodes.name: pyqYears
nodes.summary: Generates the backward-compatible descending GATE PYQ year range.

nodes.name: buildSourceRef
nodes.summary: Serializes source kind, year, GATE set, question number, and format into the canonical source reference.

nodes.name: image.ts
nodes.summary: Converts, captures, resizes, and compresses study images into bounded JPEG data URLs for the offline-first question store.

nodes.name: urlToDataUrl
nodes.summary: Fetches an allowed image URL and converts its bytes to a data URL.

nodes.name: downscaleDataUrl
nodes.summary: Draws an image to a bounded canvas and returns compressed JPEG data.

nodes.name: waitForElementMedia
nodes.summary: Waits for fonts and descendant images before rasterizing a rendered element.

nodes.name: captureElementToDataUrl
nodes.summary: Rasterizes a DOM element with theme-aware cloning, downsizes it, and enforces the image-size cap.

nodes.name: compressToDataUrl
nodes.summary: Reads an uploaded image, resizes it to the long-edge limit, compresses it, and returns dimensions and byte size.

nodes.name: ImageTooLargeError
nodes.summary: Represents a compressed image that still exceeds the application’s offline storage safety limit.

nodes.name: learning-tips.ts
nodes.summary: Applies deterministic coaching rules to recent learner evidence and returns one focused dashboard learning tip.

nodes.name: buildLearningTips
nodes.summary: Selects one actionable coaching tip from recent mistakes, pace, activity, and retrieval context.

nodes.name: mocks.ts
nodes.summary: Validates mock-test input and calculates score, accuracy, best/worst/latest performance, and score movement summaries.

nodes.name: validateMockDraft
nodes.summary: Validates mock identity, date, question totals, duration, and score bounds and returns the first user-facing error.

nodes.name: mockScorePercent
nodes.summary: Converts earned and maximum marks to a one-decimal percentage.

nodes.name: mockAccuracy
nodes.summary: Calculates attempted-question accuracy or returns null when nothing was attempted.

nodes.name: mockSummary
nodes.summary: Identifies best, worst, and latest mock tests and computes the latest score change.

nodes.name: pyq-history.ts
nodes.summary: Groups PYQ attempts and filters question-bank items by unseen, repeated, incorrect, guessed, slow, skipped, or unanalyzed history.

nodes.name: attemptsByQuestion
nodes.summary: Groups PYQ attempts by question and sorts each history chronologically.

nodes.name: analyzedAttemptIds
nodes.summary: Builds the set of persisted journal question IDs used to recognize analyzed attempts.

nodes.name: matchesPyqHistory
nodes.summary: Tests a PYQ against a selected history filter using latest attempts and journal analysis state.

nodes.name: filterPyqByHistory
nodes.summary: Groups attempts and filters a question list by the selected practice-history criterion.

nodes.name: pyq-session.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the durable PYQ session and attempt state machine, deterministic audit identifiers, immutable snapshots, journal linkage, and canonical practice sessions.

nodes.name: createPyqSessionRow
nodes.summary: Creates a new active PYQ set with selected question IDs, progress counters, timestamps, and bank version.

nodes.name: pyqAttemptId
nodes.summary: Derives the deterministic identifier for a question attempt within a PYQ session.

nodes.name: pyqJournalQuestionId
nodes.summary: Derives the deterministic journal question identifier for a PYQ attempt receipt.

nodes.name: pyqSourceAttemptForJournalQuestion
nodes.summary: Resolves the immutable PYQ attempt behind a journal row, including a constrained legacy fallback.

nodes.name: pyqQuestionFromAttempt
nodes.summary: Reconstructs the original bundled PYQ and answer metadata from a version-2 immutable attempt snapshot.

nodes.name: pyqReattemptAttemptId
nodes.summary: Derives one stable PYQ re-attempt receipt identifier for a ladder round.

nodes.name: createPyqReattemptAttemptRow
nodes.summary: Builds an immutable PYQ re-attempt receipt without attaching it to the already-closed original practice set.

nodes.name: pyqPracticeSubject
nodes.summary: Derives a human-readable single-subject, mixed-subject, or generic label for PYQ practice rows.

nodes.name: pyqPracticeSessionRow
nodes.summary: Projects an audited PYQ set into the canonical session model while preserving existing journal metadata.

nodes.name: startPyqSessionQuestion
nodes.summary: Validates and records the active question and start timestamp for an open PYQ set.

nodes.name: advancePyqSessionProgress
nodes.summary: Marks a question completed, advances monotonic progress, and accumulates elapsed time exactly once.

nodes.name: completePyqSession
nodes.summary: Closes a PYQ set as completed and finalizes progress and timestamps.

nodes.name: abandonPyqSession
nodes.summary: Closes a PYQ set as abandoned while clearing active-question timing state.

nodes.name: pausePyqSession
nodes.summary: Pauses an active PYQ set and clears the current question timing state.

nodes.name: pyqQuestionSnapshot
nodes.summary: Copies the immutable question-bank fields needed to audit and later restore an attempt.

nodes.name: createPyqAttemptRow
nodes.summary: Validates session state, response type, decision, timing, and bank version and creates the canonical version-2 attempt receipt.

nodes.name: pyq.ts
nodes.summary: Loads and normalizes the bundled PYQ bank, repairs question math markup, evaluates answers, formats evidence, and derives journal text, images, sources, and outcomes.

nodes.name: replaceBalancedPyqMathCommand
nodes.summary: Finds balanced braced TeX commands and replaces their bodies without corrupting nested markup.

nodes.name: joinPyqMathLines
nodes.summary: Normalizes line breaks and legacy TeX constructs inside extracted PYQ math.

nodes.name: pyqMathEndIndex
nodes.summary: Finds the unescaped closing delimiter for a PYQ math segment while respecting brace nesting.

nodes.name: normalizePyqQuestionHtml
nodes.summary: Protects and normalizes math segments while sanitizing legacy question HTML for reliable rendering.

nodes.name: loadPyqManifest
nodes.summary: Loads and memoizes the versioned PYQ bank manifest.

nodes.name: normalizePyqManifest
nodes.summary: Validates manifest schema expectations and supplies normalized topic arrays.

nodes.name: loadPyqQuestions
nodes.summary: Loads, caches, and combines version-matched subject question payloads.

nodes.name: loadPyqQuestionByUid
nodes.summary: Locates one question by stable UID, using an optional subject hint before broader lookup.

nodes.name: matchesPyqTopicScope
nodes.summary: Tests whether a question falls within the configured subject and topic practice scope.

nodes.name: evaluatePyqAnswer
nodes.summary: Evaluates MCQ, MSQ, or NAT responses while respecting skips, unavailable keys, and numeric tolerance.

nodes.name: formatPyqAnswer
nodes.summary: Formats the authoritative answer according to the question type and answer status.

nodes.name: pyqAnswerValueForLog
nodes.summary: Normalizes the authoritative answer into the value persisted with an attempt receipt.

nodes.name: wrapSnapshotText
nodes.summary: Wraps plain question text into bounded lines for a generated snapshot image.

nodes.name: pyqQuestionSnapshotDataUrl
nodes.summary: Builds an SVG data URL snapshot containing question identity and readable prompt text.

nodes.name: pyqSourceRef
nodes.summary: Builds the canonical source reference for a bundled GATE PYQ.

nodes.name: pyqPlainText
nodes.summary: Converts question HTML and math markup into readable plain text for journals and snapshots.

nodes.name: firstPyqImage
nodes.summary: Extracts the first image URL from question HTML when present.

nodes.name: resolvePyqJournalImageUrl
nodes.summary: Converts a discovered PYQ image to storable data or falls back to a generated question snapshot.

nodes.name: inferPyqDirectOutcome
nodes.summary: Infers a direct tag outcome from answer correctness, decision confidence, and target-relative solve time.

nodes.name: questionTags.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the missing-tag confirmation policy; the current policy allows saving without pattern or trigger confirmation.

nodes.name: needsMissingTagsConfirmation
nodes.summary: Returns the current policy decision for saving questions without pattern or trigger tags.
